get.summary: Retrieve consultation appointment attachments by filters
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of attachments that belong to the given consultation appointment, optionally filtered by file name (case-insensitive partial match). Each attachment includes its Base64-encoded file content. Returns 200 OK with a populated page when attachments are found, or an empty page (content: []) when no attachments match the filters. Returns 400 when the appointment identifier is invalid or the pagination parameters are invalid. Returns 404 when the appointment does not exist. 

Check the TIE configuration documentation under the 'Guides > Schedules use case > Schedule attachments configuration' tab.

parameters.name: appointmentId
parameters.description:
Consultation appointment identifier

**Referenced Table:** AGENDA_CONSULTA

**Referenced Column:** NR_SEQUENCIA

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Defines the current page of the paginated response (starts at 1)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of results per page (default: 10)

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description:
Filters the attachments whose file path and name contain the informed text (case-insensitive).

**Referenced Table:** ANEXO_AGENDA_CONS

**Referenced Column:** DS_ARQUIVO

get.summary: Retrieve a consultation appointment attachment by identifier
get.description:
Retrieves a single attachment that belongs to a consultation appointment, including its Base64-encoded file content. The attachment is resolved by both the appointment identifier and the attachment identifier, so an attachment that is not linked to the given appointment is treated as not found. Returns 200 OK when the attachment is found. Returns 400 when the appointment or attachment identifier is null or lower than one. Returns 404 when the appointment does not exist or the attachment does not belong to it. 

Check the TIE configuration documentation under the 'Guides > Schedules use case > Schedule attachments configuration' tab.
